question: A merchant increases the cost price of an item by 30% and offers a discount of 15% on this marked price. What is his profit percentage?
solution:
Given:

Discount % = 15%

Mark-up = 30%

Formula:

SP - CP = Profit

Profit % = (SP - CP)/CP × 100

Selling price = Marked price × Discount/100
